chunks: He is guided whom God guides. As for him He allows to go astray, you will not find a protector other than Him. We shall raise them on the Day of Resurrection in their own image, blind and dumb and deaf: Their habitation will be Hell. Every time (its fire) subsides We will intensify its flame.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'He is guided whom God guides' in the context of divine decree and the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine wisdom behind the sealing of hearts for those who persist in rejecting the Imams and the Prophet's message, linking their spiritual blindness to their physical state on Judgment Day. The imagery of being gathered 'on their faces' signifies a reversal of their upright posture in life, while the renewal of the fire reflects the continuous nature of divine retribution for the stubbornly misguided.
